limitations: Daily pool consists only of trends whose absolute visible start is13OctoberEurope/Madrid. The volumes are from the rolling48-hour view, not totals for that natural day.
Weekly pool is rolling168hours, including trends begun today; source start labels retained.
GB toilet20k+ is a broad-topic signal. Volume for the exact educational question is unknown; shopping/repair intent is not claimed as addressed.
ES nueva dana20k+ is Spanish topic demand, not measured English demand or a confirmed forecast. The English explanatory long-tail volume is unknown.
Named persons, death/arrest/health rumours and unrelated match/product queries are excluded from public text. No recent disaster, death, accusation or forecast is asserted.
Variants and translations represent one topic, not additional independent terms. No country volumes are summed.
Saved research from12–13October reviewed; its Academy, aurora and clocks subjects are already covered. No paid research.
Desktop/mobile layout, derivative crops, validators, GitHub checks and public CMS verification remain gates before release.

candidates.question: How does a toilet flush without electricity?
candidates.intent: A focused free search for how does a toilet flush without electricity returned explanatory siphon/power pages and manufacturer sources. Education is the selected intent; no repair or outage instructions.
serpQueries: how does a toilet flush without electricity
how a toilet flush works siphon Kohler American Standard
observedResults: Kohler Assist — How a Toilet Flushes
This Old House — What Is a Toilet Siphon and How Does One Work?
candidates.novelty: 87 live titles and documents plus main fixtures/research checked: no toilet/flush/siphon piece. Different mechanism from ballpoint pen and zipper. Exact keyword volume unknown.

candidates.question: What is a DANA, and why can it bring heavy rain?
candidates.demand: ES Spanish nueva dana20k+, started14Oct14:30Madrid, rolling168h.
candidates.intent: Free Spanish and English explanatory searches return AEMET, National Weather Service and Royal Meteorological Society. Explain the pattern and rain chain rather than repeat a speculative forecast.
serpQueries: DANA que es depresión aislada niveles altos AEMET cold air
what is a DANA weather cut off low
observedResults: AEMET — Qué es una DANA y cómo se forma
Royal Meteorological Society — Cut-off lows, cold drops and DANA
candidates.novelty: 87live documents reviewed: hurricane-eye page explains sinking centre vs rising eyewall; this piece explains detachment from upper winds, moisture and persistence. No duplicated question. English volume unknown.

sourceNotes: Kohler used for siphonic flush sequence and mechanical float only; not every toilet is siphonic. EPA distinguishes flush designs and confirms efficiency/performance testing.
AEMET definition/detachment/convection checked against NWS exact glossary and RMetS. Met Office rain formation checked. No rainfall figures,20-year recurrence or event-attribution claims reused.
Meteochile official source also opened for general cross-check; no deaths or historical totals copied.
Fluidmaster PDF returned429 and guessed MetOffice/types-of-rain404; neither is a cited or successfully opened source.
